method: V155 prone and can't stand. Builds reuse reviewed source-derived witnesses (paths in each 'base'). damageByTier is handwritten arithmetic from the pinned Compendium ability file: printed tier constants + the named characteristic score + the kit damage bonus only for damage-dealing Melee+Weapon or Ranged+Weapon abilities (chapter/kits.md Damage Bonuses; the Conduit has no kit, and feature/conduit/level-1/prayer-of-soldiers-skill.md adds +1 to weapon abilities only). Potency follows rule/character/potency.md (weak = score - 2, average = score - 1, strong = score) with the class potency characteristic (class/conduit.md Basics: Intuition; class/shadow.md Basics: Agility); a condition applies only if the potency is higher than the target's score. Per the user's 2026-09-24 ruling (docs/decisions/2026-09-24-automation-rulings.md section 5): 'prone and can't stand (save ends)' is a prone with no duration, ended only by Stand Up (condition/prone.md; feature/common/maneuvers/stand-up.md), plus a separate can't-stand restriction carrying the save; Stand Up is refused while the restriction is active, and the creature stays prone when it ends. Saving throws follow rule/general/saving-throw.md: a d10 at the end of each of the affected creature's turns, 6 or higher ends the effect. Tiers follow rule/dice/tier-outcome.md (11 or lower, 12-16, 17+); dice are real, so the journey repeats Staggering Blow without edges until a tier-2/3 (can't stand) result: 2d10 + A 2 >= 12 has probability 64/100 per use (2d10 <= 9 in 36 of 100 outcomes), so maxAttempts 8 fails only with probability 0.36^8, about 0.03%. Edges are deliberately not used: feature/shadow/level-1/insight.md makes an edged heroic ability cost 1 fewer insight, which is not asserted here. Nothing is derived from the evaluator, compiler or a run of the code under test.

target.base: tests/fixtures/v100-conduit-expected.json v100-sun; array 2, 1, 1, -1 replaced by the listed array 2, 2, -1, -1 assigned Might -1, Agility -1, Reason 2, Presence 2 (class/conduit.md Basics: I 2, any listed array for the other four)
target.note: A -1 is below the Conduit's I-based potencies 0/1/2 and M -1 below the Shadow's A-based potencies 0/1/2 (rule/character/potency.md), so every prone and can't-stand clause of Judgment's Hammer and Staggering Blow applies. Stamina maximum 24 = Conduit 18 + feature/conduit/level-1/prayer-of-steel.md +6 (v100-sun, unchanged by characteristics); it exceeds the largest hit, Staggering Blow tier 3 (19). Saving throw threshold 6 (rule/general/saving-throw.md; v100-sun savingThrowThreshold 6; the Inner Light respite ritual is inactive, as in v100). Human Determination and Can't Take Hold are optional player choices that touch neither prone nor can't stand (feature/trait/human/*.md).

action.name: Judgment's Hammer
action.derivation: Magic, Ranged, Strike (3 Piety; v100 paidSourceCosts): printed 3/6/9 + I 2 holy; no kit and no Weapon keyword, so no kit or Soldier's Skill bonus = 5/8/11.
action.effectsDerivation: Tier 1 'A < WEAK, prone', tier 2 'A < AVERAGE, prone', tier 3 'A < STRONG, prone and can't stand (save ends)'. With Conduit I 2 the thresholds are A < 0/1/2; target A -1 is below each, so prone applies at every tier and can't stand (save ends) at tier 3 only.

action.name: Staggering Blow
action.derivation: Melee, Ranged, Strike, Weapon (7 Insight): printed 7/11/16 + A 2 + kit/cloak-and-dagger.md +1/+1/+1 (its melee and ranged bonuses are equal, so either distance gives the same) = 10/14/19 (v98-shadow-4 damageByTier).
action.effectsDerivation: Tier 1 'M < WEAK, slowed (save ends)', tiers 2/3 'M < AVERAGE/STRONG, prone and can't stand (save ends)'. With Shadow A 2 the thresholds are M < 0/1/2; target M -1 is below each, so tier 1 applies slowed (save ends) and tiers 2/3 apply prone and can't stand (save ends).
